quarterly_data.signal: Revenue contribution schedule (Q2 2026 earnings conference deck): FAU and DFAU - trace amount in 2026/Q3, then revenue on a quarterly basis from 2026/Q4 in line with the client's milestones; the existing patch cord and optical component business from the Shanghai, Zhongshan and Thailand plants was the primary revenue in 2026H1, with small-scale volume from Thailand in 2026/Q4.

quarterly_data.quarter: FOCI Fiber Optic Communications IR presentation: MOPS 336320260902E001 (09-03-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: CPO progress (company deck): >5 different MCM CPO packages delivered and >5 additional customers to design-in; completed 20, 36, 40 and 80 channels FAU development, continuing toward 100+ channels and WDM; detachable 80CH/40CH/36CH FAU for MCM/OOI co-packaged optics; FAU withstands 260°C reflow; developing an optical FAU probe for testing with automated assembly and inspection production. The mass production plan now lists delivery of specified quantities of 3.2T (+) FAU, then 3.2T and 6.4T (+) FAU.
